headline: Tunisia: Global Revenue of Listed Companies on the Tunis Stock Exchange Up 4.2% at End of September 2026
summary: Revenue of companies listed on the Tunis stock exchange rose 4.2% in the first nine months of 2026 compared with the same period of 2025. The figures come from an exchange note.
why: The Tunis stock exchange is Tunisia's main securities market, and listed company revenues indicate the health of the local corporate sector.
original_headline: Tunisie : Hausse de 4,2% du revenu global des sociétés cotées à la Bourse de Tunis à fin septembre 2026
